name: G超起始牌組「美夢成真組合篇」
englishName: GX Starter Deck: Dreams Come True Collection

description.text: GX Starter Deck: Dreams Come True Collection, the second Traditional Chinese release: a random 60-card deck, ready to play, with damage counters, GX markers and a rule book; each deck always held one Pokémon-GX, along with Trainer cards often played in battles. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
